name: Open-MP | Loxy v2.3
author: danielolxlol@gmail.com
description: Egg Open-MP modernizada para Pterodactyl com runtime Debian 12/Bookworm ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:samp e startup remoto da Loxy Systems. O instalador usa armazenamento temporário dentro do próprio volume do servidor para evitar erros 'No space left on device' causados pelo /tmp limitado do container de instalação, preservando arquivos existentes do cliente.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
REPO="openmultiplayer/open.mp"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"

# IMPORTANTE:
# Não usar /tmp para extrair o OpenMP. O container de instalação pode ter
# espaço temporário limitado, gerando "No space left on device".
TMP_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.loxy-openmp-install"

cleanup() {
    rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}/extract"

echo "=================================================="
echo "      Open-MP Installer - Loxy Systems v2.3"
echo "=================================================="

echo "[1/6] Preparando dependencias do instalador..."
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    tar \
    unzip \
    file
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"

echo "[2/6] Preparando download do open.mp..."

if [[ -z "${VERSION}" || "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
    RELEASE_BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download"
    RELEASE_LABEL="latest"
else
    RELEASE_BASE="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}"
    RELEASE_LABEL="${VERSION}"
fi

echo "[3/6] Baixando open.mp ${RELEASE_LABEL}..."

DOWNLOAD_OK=0

for ASSET in \
    "open.mp-linux-x86-dynssl.tar.gz" \
    "open.mp-linux-x86.tar.gz"
do
    echo "[DOWNLOAD] Tentando ${ASSET}..."
    if curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
        -o "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" \
        "${RELEASE_BASE}/${ASSET}"; then
        DOWNLOAD_OK=1
        echo "[DOWNLOAD] Asset selecionado: ${ASSET}"
        break
    fi
done

if [[ "${DOWNLOAD_OK}" != "1" ]]; then
    echo "[ERRO] Nao foi possivel baixar o open.mp ${RELEASE_LABEL}."
    echo "[ERRO] Verifique se a versao informada existe."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[4/6] Extraindo arquivos no volume do servidor..."
tar -xzf "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" -C "${TMP_DIR}/extract"

if [[ -d "${TMP_DIR}/extract/Server" ]]; then
    OMP_ROOT="${TMP_DIR}/extract/Server"
else
    OMP_BINARY="$(find "${TMP_DIR}/extract" -type f -name omp-server -print -quit || true)"
    if [[ -z "${OMP_BINARY}" ]]; then
        echo "[ERRO] O pacote baixado nao contem omp-server."
        exit 1
    fi
    OMP_ROOT="$(dirname "${OMP_BINARY}")"
fi

echo "[5/6] Instalando sem sobrescrever arquivos existentes..."
cp -a -n "${OMP_ROOT}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"

if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/omp-server" ]]; then
    echo "[ERRO] omp-server nao foi instalado."
    exit 1
fi

BASE_URL="https://github.com/drysius/Eggs/raw/main/Connect/Open-MP/SampGmBase.zip"

if curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
    -o "${TMP_DIR}/SampGmBase.zip" \
    "${BASE_URL}"; then
    unzip -nq "${TMP_DIR}/SampGmBase.zip" -d "${SERVER_DIR}" || true
else
    echo "[AVISO] Gamemode base nao foi baixada. Continuando."
fi

echo "[6/6] Ajustando configuracao e permissoes..."

if [[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg" ]]; then
    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*rcon_password[[:space:]]+' "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "rcon_password ${RCON_PASSWORD:-MeMudePorFavor}" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi

    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*output[[:space:]]+' "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"; then
        echo "output 1" >> "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg"
    fi
fi

chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/omp-server"

find "${SERVER_DIR}/plugins" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.so" -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
find "${SERVER_DIR}/components" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.so" -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=================================================="
echo " Instalacao concluida: open.mp ${RELEASE_LABEL}"
echo " Runtime: ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/games:samp"
echo " Startup remoto: LoxyHosting/loxy-game-eggs/openmp.sh"
echo "=================================================="
